item.title: Inspecting a Modified 2021 Audi S4 With Mechanical Damage
item.description: A 2021 Audi S4 purchased for $13,000 at Copart has extensive aftermarket modifications but shows signs of engine trouble. A specialist helps investigate the cause of the misfires and unusual running behavior.
